title: What is three fifths times four?
description: The video finds three fifths times four by writing four as four over one and then multiplying the tops and the bottoms. Keeko then raises a hand with the doubt that the four goes into both the top and the bottom.
teaching_notes: One idea: a whole number can be written with one at the bottom, and then the tops multiply and the bottoms multiply. Watch for students who multiply the whole number into both the top and the bottom.

video_script.why: The child has written a whole number as a fraction when it came first and now does it when it comes second.
video_script.substitution: Four is the same as four over one, so three fifths times four is the product of two fractions.
video_script.wrong_move: multiplies the four into both the top and the bottom and gets twelve twentieths, which is three fifths again
video_script.payoff_line: Three fifths times four is twelve fifths, which is two and two fifths

final_answer.spoken: twelve fifths, which is two and two fifths

video_script.fraction_reading: three fifths, four over one, twelve fifths, two and two fifths, twelve twentieths
maths_rules: the slip: 12/20 = 3/5, the fraction we started with
video_script.design: One idea: a whole number is a fraction with one at the bottom, so the tops multiply and the bottoms multiply. The four whole squares are the anchor and stay all video; the working band builds in the idea part.

<bookmark mark='top'/>Step three, work out the top and the bottom.
<bookmark mark='bottom'/>Three times four is twelve, and five times one is five.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Twelve fifths has ten fifths in two wholes, and two fifths are left.
<bookmark mark='mixed'/>Three fifths times four is twelve fifths, which is two and two fifths.

marks.rule: 4 = 4/1 is written, and 5 × 1 is marked at the bottom

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the answer is twelve twentieths.
Keeko multiplied the four into both the top and the bottom.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But twelve twentieths is the same as three fifths.
Three fifths times four must be bigger than three fifths.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Write four as four over one, and then the bottom is five times one.
